name: 調理開始と分量・材料を備えたレシピの紹介
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE high fidelity Japanese Lighthouse component image for LH19-0001, a recipe overview. Portrait composition, pure white #FFFFFF canvas, compact complete card with comfortable modest outside margins, no phone/device frame, no caption outside the component.
Input image 1 is our saved native/mock preview and establishes ALL exact content, order and crop. Image 2 is the actual original cookie-photo crop: preserve this photograph and its composition/colors rather than inventing food. Image 3 is approved STYLE guidance only: white rounded cards, fine neutral outlines, soft downward elevation, forest-green gradient actions. Do not add any bus/map content.
Recreate the mock with refined alignment and surface hierarchy. Heading Meiryo Bold 20/28 at logical phone scale, regular body Meiryo 14/24, metadata 12/16, tracking zero. Do not make all text bold. Preserve the top title and wide cookie image. Primary full-width rounded button with white outline play triangle and exact label 「調理を始める」, smooth gradient #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E, restrained edge light/shadow. Below, two quieter white neutral-outline controls 「買い物」 and 「共有」. Metadata 「12人分」 at left and 「下準備 10分」 at right. Section title 「材料」 and a white outlined 「分量を調整」 control.
Preserve these exact nine ingredient rows in two aligned columns:
1 cup | 無塩バター（室温）
1 cup | グラニュー糖
1 cup | ブラウンシュガー
2個（大） | 卵
小さじ1 | バニラエッセンス
3 cup | オールパーパス粉
小さじ1 | 重曹
小さじ1/2 | 塩
2 cup | チョコチップ
Title verbatim: 「チョコチップクッキー」.
Keep all rows and controls visible without clipping. Supporting icons and quantities use coherent slate #526173, main ink #1D1D1D, secondary #6E6E6E. Original colored shopping/share/quantity accents are adapted to slate because they are ordinary utilities, not status/group distinctions; green primary action remains the one emphasis. Preserve photograph colors. No broad mint panels, invented ingredients, unit conversions, decorative metrics, extra navigation, heavy gloss, rainbow icons, watermarks. This is a static design candidate; do not add implementation claims.
reviewNotes: 原本・写真切抜き・日本語モック・独立編集確認を実見。原本のミント開始／橙の買物／紫の共有／青の分量は、森林色の主要操作とスレートの補助操作へ整理。日本語9材料行・人数12・下準備10分・操作4点を確認。写真は再描画され原本との厳密一致は未達。フォント寸法の厳密比較、所有者承認、編集可能性、アプリ動作は未認定。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
